ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Creature Behaviors
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
SHIP_VERMIN_MOD_1 (owner ruling, 2026-09-11, on the Scarlands and Webwork kit-placement cards): a small shared engine assembly for generic JobGiver/MapComponent creature-AI classes that more than one future mod needs, so nothing gets duplicated per-species or dumped into mandrake.rm.environmentalhazards (which stays hazards-only, no creature AI).
RM tier: nothing here knows what species, biome or campaign uses it. Every class is driven entirely by DefModExtensions a content mod attaches to its own race/pawnKind via an ordinary XML patch — this mod ships zero content defs of its own beyond the plumbing (a JobDef and two insertable ThinkTreeDefs).
First consumer: ShipVermin (mandrake.rm.shipvermin, the mynock and future ship-infesting critters). Reserved for later, per the owner's ruling on the Webwork kit-placement card: a future Greentide standalone mod and a future Shokk RimStarWars-tier mod (SHOKK_RSW_MOD_1) will also depend on this mod rather than re-implement the same primitives.
Ships: 1. RM_MapComponent_VerminPopulation — per-map population tracker. Any race carrying RM_VerminPressureExtension is counted by its populationGroupTag; GetPressure() returns 0..1 scaled between the extension's soft and hard population caps ("nuisance unless there are many" — owner-verbatim ruling, 2026-09-11 — implemented as an actual scaling curve other comps and JobGivers read, not a comment). 2. RM_CompVerminBreeder (+ RM_CompProperties_VerminBreeder) — a lord-free, population-capped breeder comp: spawns an adjacent copy of the parent pawn on an interval, refusing once RM_MapComponent_VerminPopulation reports the race's hard cap reached on this map. Deliberately NOT vanilla CompSpawnerPawn: that comp always builds a Lord for its spawns (RimSage-verified against CompSpawnerPawn.TrySpawnPawn), which would fight a vermin's own think-tree behavior. 3. RM_SeekTargetExtension + RM_JobGiver_SeekMarkedTerrain — generic "walk to and linger on a data-tagged cell" behavior (gravship substructure, by defName-listed terrain, or both). No-ops instantly for any pawn whose race lacks the extension, so it is safe to insert globally. 4. RM_GnawTargetExtension + RM_JobGiver_GnawTargets + RM_JobDriver_Gnaw (JobDef RM_Gnaw) — generic "chew a data-listed building/comp/floor terrain for nutrition" behavior. Bite damage and job-seek frequency both scale with RM_MapComponent_VerminPopulation's pressure value — the mechanical form of "nuisance unless there are many": lone vermin gnaw rarely and lightly, a swarm gnaws often and hard. 5. RM_ThinkTree_VerminBehaviors — a ThinkTreeDef with insertTag="Animal_PreMain", so the two JobGivers above are tried for every animal in the game (vanilla's own extension point for this, Verse.AI.ThinkNode_SubtreesByTag) but do nothing unless the pawn's race carries the matching extension. 6. RM_Alert_VerminPopulationBase — abstract Alert base; a concrete mod (ShipVermin's RM_Alert_ShipVermin) supplies the group tag and label.
Live proof is OWED: this mod has not yet been loaded in a running game.
